summary: Known vmware.vmware_rest issue: its lookup plugins use cloud.common, which doesn't support ansible-core 2.19+.
questions: Why do vmware_rest lookup plugins fail on ansible-core 2.19?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest lookups fail on core 2.19
answer_card.answer_md: The `vmware.vmware_rest` lookup plugins depend on `cloud.common`, which doesn't support ansible-core 2.19 or newer.
